title: Meet the first partners of the augo Racing Team 2027
seoTitle: augo Racing Team 2027 Partners: Cyclometry, Purpose, PF&H & HRV4Training
description: Cyclometry (bike fit and mental training), Purpose (race suits), Precision Fuel & Hydration (nutrition) and HRV4Training (physiology tracking and recovery) are the partners of the augo Racing Team 2027. Here’s what our coach and athlete duos get.
coverImageAlt: The logos of the augo Racing Team 2027 partners, Cyclometry, Purpose and Precision Fuel & Hydration, side by side on black
bodyHtml:
The augo Racing Team 2027 has its partners. Four brands we trust are joining us to help our coach and athlete duos ride better, fuel smarter, recover well and race in kit made just for them.

Here’s who they are and what our team gets.

On this page

  • Cyclometry: bike fit and mental training
  • Purpose: our suit partner
  • Precision Fuel & Hydration: our nutrition partner
  • HRV4Training: our physiology tracking and recovery partner
  • Ready for 2027
  • FAQ

Cyclometry: bike fit and mental training

Cyclometry is a bike fitting and sport mental training studio in Mellingen, Switzerland, about half an hour from Zurich. It’s run by Kai Sikorski, a sports engineer, bike fitter and mental trainer who started Cyclometry in 2016.

The bike fit is done in person, on your own bike. It’s clamped to a smart trainer while nine high-speed cameras track how you pedal. You watch yourself on a screen and can fix things in real time. Saddle pressure is measured too, so you know if your saddle really fits. You leave with a report on your pedalling and all the key measurements of your setup, which is handy if you ever switch bikes.

VGT (Vegetatives Training) is mental training built around your body’s own ability to calm down and reset. The idea is to recover faster after hard sessions and stressful moments, like a big race. The intro session can be done online, so you don’t need to live nearby.

What the team gets: a bike fit plus a VGT intro for CHF 550 instead of CHF 735.

Purpose: our suit partner

Purpose makes race suits and performance wear for triathlon, running and cycling. Their suits use a light Hypermesh fabric made to keep you cool when racing in heat and humidity, and they’re worn by pro triathletes around the world.

What the team gets: every athlete gets their own personalised Purpose suit, for road running or trail. Free.

Precision Fuel & Hydration: our nutrition partner

Precision Fuel & Hydration (PF&H) helps athletes find their own hydration and fuelling plan, based on how much they sweat and how hard they go, not on one-size-fits-all advice. Their range covers electrolytes, plus PF 30 gels and chews with 30 g of carbs each. Their free Fuel & Hydration Planner helps you work out your numbers for race day.

PF&H also supported our launch event in March, so we’re really happy to team up again.

What the team gets: a welcome package, plus 25% off PF&H products for the whole year.

HRV4Training: our physiology tracking and recovery partner

HRV4Training measures your heart rate variability (HRV) in the morning, with your phone camera or a heart rate sensor. Tracked over time, it shows how your body is responding to training and to the rest of life, so you can see when to push and when to back off. It was founded by Dr. Marco Altini, who is also an advisor to augo.

HRV4Training Pro is the analysis platform on top of the app. Athletes use it to look deeper at their own data, and coaches use it to follow how each of their athletes is responding.

What the team gets: HRV4Training Pro, free, for every athlete and every coach on the team.

Ready for 2027

Bike fit, mindset, race kit, fuelling and recovery: sorted. That leaves our duos free to do what matters, train well and race hard.

A big thank you to Cyclometry, Purpose, PF&H and HRV4Training for backing the team. More partners to be announced soon.

FAQ

Who are the partners of the augo Racing Team 2027?

Four brands: Cyclometry (bike fit and mental training), Purpose (race suits), Precision Fuel & Hydration (nutrition) and HRV4Training (physiology tracking and recovery). More partners will be announced soon.

What does the Cyclometry partnership include?

An in-person bike fit on your own bike at Cyclometry in Mellingen, Switzerland, plus an intro to VGT mental training, for CHF 550 instead of CHF 735. The VGT intro session can be done online.

What is VGT (Vegetatives Training)?

VGT is mental training built around your body’s own ability to calm down and reset. The idea is to recover faster after hard sessions and stressful moments, like a big race.

What race suit does the augo Racing Team wear?

Every athlete gets their own personalised Purpose suit, for road running or trail, free. Purpose suits use a light Hypermesh fabric made to keep you cool when racing in heat and humidity.

What nutrition support does the augo Racing Team get?

Precision Fuel & Hydration gives the team a welcome package, plus 25% off PF&H products for the whole year.

What does the HRV4Training partnership include?

Every athlete and every coach on the augo Racing Team gets HRV4Training Pro free, to track HRV and see how the body is responding to training.

How can I join the augo Racing Team?

augo sponsors five coach and athlete duos for the 2027 season, from March to October. A coach or an athlete applies and names the other half of the duo. Applications are open until December 15, 2026, and the five duos are selected in January 2027. See the augo Racing Team page or apply now.
